attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Reworks reference-counting and disposal logic for the shared in-memory LocalLock service (adding argument/dispose guards and fixing a semaphore leak), which is subtle concurrency code used across the framework, but the refactor is logically consistent (decrement-then-dispose only when no other reference exists) and is backed by a solid new unit test suite."}

reason: Reworks reference-counting and disposal logic for the shared in-memory LocalLock service (adding argument/dispose guards and fixing a semaphore leak), which is subtle concurrency code used across the framework, but the refactor is logically consistent (decrement-then-dispose only when no other reference exists) and is backed by a solid new unit test suite.
